notes: GAME PLAN — the adaptive workout scheduler. Cross-cutting layer that learns the user's schedule and free time, then routes them to a session that FITS the gap they actually have. Addresses the #1 reason people quit: TIME, not motivation. Roadmap: roadmap/game-plan-scheduler.md. Spec: specs/26-game-plan-scheduler.md. Pure logic: engine/game-plan-engine.ts. Grounded in the reminders research (implementation intentions, forgiving streaks, engagement != behavior, one well-timed nudge). NOT a 4th mode — it sits ABOVE the modes and powers the existing 'Today's Bout' card + smart notifications.

free.name: Manual Game Plan
unlocks: time->session matching for the block you tell it you have

pro.name: Adaptive Game Plan
unlocks: auto weekly plan around your real availability
adaptive session routing (busy week -> short formats; open week -> Arcade/Camp)
pro.monetization_note: Natural Pro feature. Free = manual reminders; Pro = calendar-aware auto-plan + adaptive routing.

questionnaire.description: Short setup (onboarding or Profile). Reuses the existing equipment profile + readiness system.

questions.q: What's your biggest hurdle to training?
questions.drives: time -> lead with fit-the-gap; equipment -> reuse equipment profile filtering; motivation -> lean on combo streak + nudges; dont_know -> lead with guided Missions

questions.q: Days per week you want to train?
Time per session you can usually give?

questions.note: Manual busy-day picker on free; calendar connect on Pro.

questions.q: When do you usually prefer to train?
questions.note: Self-selected cue time beats prescribed (reminders research). Used as the default reminder time.

session_catalog.description: The session types Game Plan can route to, with the time band each fits. min_min/max_min are used by the gap->session matcher. All reference existing modes — Game Plan never invents a workout, it picks one that fits.

time_to_session.description: Gap (minutes of free time) -> which session tier fits. The matcher returns eligible sessions from session_catalog whose [min_min,max_min] overlaps the gap AND whose mode the user has enabled AND whose equipment the user has.
time_to_session.rule: Pick the richest session that FITS — never one that overruns the gap. If nothing fits (gap < shortest session), suggest the shortest available and note it may run slightly over, or offer a rest/mobility micro-session.

weekly_plan.description: Generated from days_per_week + session_minutes + rest days + readiness. Distributes training days across the week, spaces hard days, and honors planned rest.
rules: Assign exactly days_per_week training slots across the 7 days.
Space training days out (avoid clustering all at the start) and avoid scheduling two HARD sessions back-to-back (ties into readiness + the plyo/sprint recovery caps in the campaigns).
Non-training days are planned REST days — they never break the combo (specs/23).
Busy week (few free blocks) -> lean short-format sessions; open week -> unlock Arcade/Camp.
Respect the readiness gate before every session: 'halt' -> reschedule/rest; 'suggest_easy_or_recovery' -> offer the Easy variant or a recovery session (completing it keeps the combo).

todays_bout.description: Game Plan POWERS the EXISTING 'Today's Bout' home card — it does not add a screen. It upgrades the card from 'here's a session' to 'here's a session that fits your free 2-3pm'.
todays_bout.logic: If a plan exists and today is a training day and the user hasn't trained yet: pick the best session for today's largest known free block (Pro: from calendar free/busy; Free: from the user's stated availability). Show the block + the session + one-tap start. If already trained: show a recovery/streak-safe state, never push a second hard session.

notifications.description: Opportunistic and never naggy. Reuses the reminders nudge policy (specs/23): one scheduled nudge/day baseline; Pro adds ONE opportunistic 'a gap appeared' nudge.
notifications.opportunistic_rule: Fire BECAUSE a real free gap appears that fits a session ('Free hour at 2 — 20-min Quick Mission?'). Only when: today is a training day, the user hasn't trained yet, it's outside quiet hours, and it's been >= the cooldown since the last nudge.
notifications.back_off: If the user already trained today, or dismissed the last opportunistic nudge, do not fire again today.
notifications.tone: Positive/coach — celebrates consistency (ties into the combo streak). Never guilt (reminders research).

calendar.description: The trust make-or-break. PRO + fully opt-in. Must also work WITHOUT calendar.
calendar.read: FREE/BUSY ONLY — never event titles or details. 'free 2-3pm', not 'therapy at 2'. This distinction IS the trust story.
calendar.source: DEVICE calendar (iOS EventKit / Android Calendar Provider) — already aggregates Google + Apple + Outlook, so one integration covers everyone with no per-provider OAuth.
calendar.fallback: Without calendar, the questionnaire's stated busy days/preferred time drive the plan. Calendar is the upgrade, not the requirement.

privacy.data: Free/busy only; device-calendar (no cloud calendar scraping); no location; schedule data is never sold or shared.
privacy.state_it_plainly: Surface this in the connect flow — the feature lives or dies on trust.

backed: forgiving streak / rest days don't break it
one well-timed nudge, engagement != behavior — from reminders research
convention_not_proven: cooldown/quiet-hours defaults — standard product practice, tune with real usage data
evidence_and_honesty.scope_note: Adaptive calendar routing is powerful but complexity; the recommended FIRST version is questionnaire + manual availability + smart notifications (NO calendar), with calendar as the Pro v2 upgrade.
